name: Imperial Settlers
summary: Empire-building card game where factions draft, produce and build locations for victory points over five rounds.
rules_text: Each player has a faction board and personal deck plus a shared common deck. Five rounds are played, each with four phases. Lookout: each player draws one faction card, then reveal N+1 common cards and draft one each clockwise, then reveal N+1 again and draft counter-clockwise from last player; last card discarded. Production: in turn order collect goods from faction board, signed deals, and production locations; goods are workers, resources, tokens, cards and VP. Action phase: clockwise take one action or pass. With pass you exit round and cannot be razed. Actions are build a location from hand paying its cost, make a deal from hand for income, raze an opponent's common location paying raze tokens, activate action locations, or trade 2 workers for a resource or card. One defense token per round may be placed on a common location to raise its raze cost by one. Cleanup: store allowed goods, discard rest, pass first player and advance round. After round five sum current VP plus 1 per common and 2 per faction location in empire.
rating_reason: Card tableau engine, turn-based, hidden hands, strategic, no board needed.
